content.thinking: I need to hedge the claim, since some shoppers' account pages actually failed. I also want to check the order of events: the list shows the demo user was resolved first and Argus reverted, so the phrase "before Argus had judged" still holds, and only the first sentence needs fixing.

input.overview: On io-shop, account pages failed for some shoppers over {duration}. Turning on a new monthly-spending feature made those pages run a calculation that tried to divide by zero. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests failed. Argus estimates the incident cost the shop {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody was paged, so no on-call responder was called in. To end it, Argus reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature, and that change is still in place. A demo user then closed the incident from the Argus UI before Argus had judged whether the revert worked. The demo user noted that they had kept the flag off and told the checkout team.
